verdict.rationale: The CPU is a desktop processor without an integrated GPU/media engine — AMD's Ryzen desktop CPUs (non-G/APU SKUs like the 9950X3D) lack an iGPU, so there is no on-chip hardware AV1/HEVC/ProRes encode/decode engine as would exist in an APU or dedicated GPU/media chip. Evidence only cites general creative-workload acceleration and DaVinci Resolve marketing language, not a documented on-die hardware media/video codec engine.
